summary: Down 0.1 from w13 (8.5), with no high-severity issues. Most of the w13 list is fixed. The trim-A back weave now has ordered brick rows instead of 'TV static' (w14b/fab_montage.png). The pocket sits low in a tall recess, with a holder plate and a wide leaflet, and the plain shell under it is down to a few cm (p2, p6). The bezel is lighter (#181a22, was #0f1116), and the cushion is slightly bluer (S 0.13, was 0.10). Three things hold the score back. (1) Medium, new: the trim-A ear chips on their own tile now read as uniform round polka dots. Blob elongation is 1.38 against 1.63 in py_37305, the median chip area is 2x py_37305's, and the visible small flecks are missing. The notches do not survive the mip, and the 140 tiny specks are too faint (gain 0.3-0.6) to show. The signature sakura confetti in py_37305 / 37301 / 37303 is irregular, pointed and mixed in size (p4, q14, q13 foreground). (2) Low-medium: the weave overshot. p8 back p90/p50 is 1.37 against 1.25 and high-pass SD 0.210 against 0.179. q14 measures 1.35 / 0.199 against py_37303's 1.23 / 0.144, so in-cabin backs read busier and more white-on-navy than the calm grey weave. The blocks still sit apart on a dark ground (fill about 0.37), while the photo shows pale blocks with thin dark mortar. (3) Low-medium: the denser trim-B petal tile shows a repeating 'Y / asterisk' cluster motif at q13 distance (w14b/q13_B.png), and w13 did not have it.
lighting_note: Not scored. The sun diamond is still on the 26B back in q14 (x 490-550, y 310-400). The p8 top-lit cushions still wash to grey-white (light #dee3eb). The q13 trim-B back mean is #606a80, S 0.25, against py_37302's #697a9f, S 0.34 (cooler, more saturated photo light). In q13b the camera is inside the seat ahead, so the magnified navy band, weave blocks and big ear hexagons in the foreground are not scored. They do confirm the ear chips are hexagons, not petals.

issues.issue: The trim-A ear chips read as uniform round or hexagonal polka dots: even size, even spacing, no pointed tips or notches, and no visible small flecks. In py_37305 (and as fine flecks in py_37301 / 37303) the sakura confetti is irregular. The chips are mixed in size, from many 2-4 mm flecks to about 8 mm petals, and are pointed or notched, with an elongation of about 1.6.
issues.evidence: w14b/petal_montage.png, bottom row: py_37305 ear, q13 foreground ear, p4 ear. Blob stats at 1.45x the median: py_37305 has n 110, median area 1.15e-3 W^2, elongation 1.63 and solidity 0.84; w14 p4 has n 54, 2.34e-3, 1.38 and 0.87. The tile (w14b/tiles.png, left) has 18 hexagons of req N(10, 3) at gain 4.2, with 140 specks at gain 0.3-0.6, too faint to register. The notch (nd 0.22 / 0.35, angular width 0.25 rad) is lost in the mip. q14 (x 220-300, y 150-240) and q13 (x 770-880) show the polka-dot read in the cabin.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py synth_py_confetti(ear=True): (1) Chips 18 -> 26, spacing 30 -> 24, req N(10, 3) clip 5-15 -> lognormal: np.clip(np.exp(rng.normal(np.log(7), 0.35)), 4, 12). (2) Elongation uniform(1.1, 1.9) -> uniform(1.4, 2.2) and tip term 0.18*cos(th) -> 0.35*cos(th), so the chips are pointed. Notch nd 0.35 on 60 % (was 40 %), with the notch width 0.25 -> 0.45 rad so it survives the mip. Use k = rng.integers(4, 6) (fewer sides) for angular facets instead of hexagons. (3) Add a mid layer of 40 small bright flecks (gain 3.0-4.0, req 2-3.5 px, elongation 1.3-2.0, random angle) instead of relying on the faint specks. Target on p4 ear: cover 0.16-0.17, elongation about 1.6, median blob area about 1.2e-3 W^2, n about 90-110.
